{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column
print(df_completed['revenue'].head())
print(df_completed['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for thousands separators
print(df_completed['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.,]', na=False).any())"}
